listening.title: First meeting at the client's office

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Good morning. I'm Minh from BrightSoft. I have a meeting with Ms. Linh at ten.

lines.speaker: Linh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Hi Minh, I'm Linh. Nice to meet you. Did you find the office easily?

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Yes, thank you. Reception was very helpful and gave me a visitor badge quickly.

lines.speaker: Linh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Good. Please have a seat. Would you like some water or tea?

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Tea would be great, thanks. Your office has a lovely view of the river.

lines.speaker: Linh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Thanks, we moved here last year. So, tell me a bit about BrightSoft.

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: We build warehouse software for logistics companies. Here is our company profile.

lines.speaker: Linh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Interesting. We still track most of our stock in spreadsheets.

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: I see. Before I show anything, may I ask what your main goal is this year?

lines.speaker: Linh (Operations Manager)
lines.text: We want to reduce mistakes in delivery orders by half.

lines.speaker: Minh (Sales Executive)
lines.text: That's clear. We'd love to help, and we hope to become a long-term partner.

questions.q: How does Linh's company track stock now?
What is Linh's main goal this year?
